[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Not really scented at all. The formula spreads easily and absorbs well into the skin. It comes out of the tube white and leaves a fresh sensation once applied. It blends well, so there isn't a cast left on the skin.

avis.titre: Best for normal to oily skin
avis.texte: Not really scented at all, I used it after my byoma hydrating milky toner, and after the ordinary toner, and it layered with my other products really well. I think on a scale of 1-5 on hydrating, this one is about a 2.5. The squalane and glycerin make it to where your skin is softer afterwards, and the glycerin does hydrate your skin. Theres no vitamin B5 or niacinamide which would give more hydration throughout the day but this is a nice formula that is light weight and pairs well with other things. I wouldn't personally reach for it often because I have very dry/sensitive skin, but if you have a normal face type and are looking for a little boost to your skin, it's a great option. The actual formula is white, comes out thinner, spreads well and gives a fresh sensation being put on, dries fairly quickly.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I recently tried the Byoma Hydrating Serum with Triceramide Complex, and I'm very impressed with the results. This serum delivers a noticeable boost of hydration without feeling heavy or greasy, making it perfect for daily use. The triceramide complex helps to strengthen the skin barrier, and I noticed my skin feeling smoother and more resilient after a week of consistent use. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly, which is great for layering under moisturizer or makeup. I also appreciate that it's fragrance-free and gentle, suitable for sensitive skin types. My only minor critique is that while it's hydrating, it may not be enough on its own for very dry skin, especially in colder weather. Pairing it with a richer moisturizer is key for maximum benefit. Overall, I'd give the Byoma Hydrating Serum a solid 4/5 for its effective hydration, skin barrier support, and ease of use.
